svg.title: Generating and choosing alternatives
svg.desc: How are possibilities offered and shaped? Separate presenting a choice space, producing new content, and bounding the generation process. A continuation is not necessarily a set of alternatives. Source illustration: A text snippet exposes explicit actions for generating a revised version while the author continues composing.

text.tspan: How are possibilities offered and shaped?
Provides candidate outputs, continuations or a space of possibilities
that people can explore, constrain and select from.
